about.title: About Independent Insurance Counselors
text: Insurance can be confusing. At Independent Insurance Counselors, we are here to help. We’ll be your guides through the process so you can come out the other side feeling confident in your protection. Whether you’re protecting your business, yourself, or your family, we have the coverage that you need.

Our agency works with you, for you. We help you find the coverage you need from several top-rated insurance carriers so you have flexibility when it comes to your protection. Contact us today to find out more about how we can help you plan for the future.
Independent Insurance Counselors offers a variety of insurance by industry, business insurance, employee benefits, and personal insurance solutions to help you protect what matters most.
